SSE generation with cookie auth: created new TEST_SSE Pothole job as client, clicked Generate Plan (GPT-5.2), all 3 stage badges (stage-retrieving, stage-geocoding, stage-drafting) rendered, stream-preview showed streaming text, generation completed with plan+layout(10 SVGs)+map(14 markers)+6 TMM citations. Admin regression: Users modal loads (admin+client emails visible), KB modal loads (TMM docs visible). critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js:34 uses `useMemo(..., [user])` with eslint-disable — technically login/register/logout are stable closures reading state from the closure's `user`, but they call `setUser` directly so re-creating them per render is fine; the eslint-disable is safe here.
server.py:90 set_auth_cookie sets samesite='none', secure=True, path='/'. Correct for cross-site cookie auth from the preview domain. Confirmed via Set-Cookie header inspection.
auth.py:28 get_current_user reads cookie first, then Authorization Bearer fallback. Correct precedence; matches spec.

sse.js:8 throws generic 'Generation failed (HTTP N)' without reading response body — if backend returns a JSON detail (e.g. quota exceeded), UI shows only the status code. Consider awaiting res.json() for error surface. Non-blocking.
server.py:130 POST /auth/logout deletes cookie without requiring auth — this is fine (idempotent) but means an unauthenticated client hitting logout still gets 200. Acceptable.

Dashboard.js flags 5 pre-existing TEST_ prefixed draft jobs in client sidebar (leftovers from prior iterations). Not a regression from this iteration; consider a one-shot cleanup script if UI clutter matters.
